name: Stećci Medieval Tombstone Graveyards
countries: Serbia, Croatia, Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: Scattered across Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Montenegro and western Serbia, these 28 graveyards hold stećci, heavy limestone tombstones carved between the 12th and 16th centuries. They stand in neat rows, many shaped like slabs or chests and covered in carved motifs and inscriptions. One of the finest groups, Radimlja near Stolac, sits in an open field.
